maya: Heads-up: CI perf alert on my PR (https://github.com/redwoodinc/redwood/pull/13131). microbench thresholds tripped in the batcher KV path, blocking merge. Perf bot report below. @jonathan @kai :eyes:

perf-bot: [perf-ci] Alert: microbench threshold diff detected for pr-13131
- microbench/batcher_latency: baseline=4.2ms, change=+33% (5.6ms) -> THRESHOLD FAILED
- kv_cache/hit_latency_p50: baseline=0.8ms -> 1.1ms (+37%)
link: https://ci.internal/builds/12345

jonathan: Repro locally?

maya: Trying a local run now, but CI numbers look consistent across runners 2/3

kai: Can you paste the failing output? Also any recent kernel selector changes in this PR?

maya: Here's the failing snippet:
```
FAILED: microbench_batcher_latency
baseline: 4.2ms
current: 5.6ms
diff: +33% (exceeds 15% threshold)
stack: runtime::batcher::wait_loop +0x123
```

sasha: I saw batch timer jitter earlier in master after the timer rework (merge #12999). Might be related.

jonathan: I can run a bisect against recent merges. Suggests starting between merge 12999 and 13088. Also check kernel selection heuristic change in 13110.

maya: Also noticed kv cache eviction counts up ~+20% in telemetry for the CI run.

kai: If KV eviction increased, requests might fall back to coldpath causing extra latency. Can you attach the perf flamegraph? small snippet ok.

maya: uploading flamegraph (https://assets.internal/flame/fg-13131.svg) -- heat at batcher::process_and_emit and runtime::kv::fetch_coldpath

perf-bot: CI runs: runner-3, runner-7, runner-12 all show consistent +30% on batcher_latency

jonathan: I'll bisect. If we confirm it's a recent merge, we should revert the offending merge until we have a fix. Can we reproduce with --local-batch-size=8?

maya: repro w/ --local-batch-size=8 yes

kai: Quick patch idea: revert the timer smoothing tweak in kernel selector and re-run perf CI. If that brings numbers back, we can follow with a proper fix.

sasha: +1 to revert if bisect confirms

jonathan: Starting bisect job now, ping when you have logs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya: Thanks, will keep this thread updated.
